What we do

Legal, tax and strategic counsel that travels with your business.

Most firms hand you an opinion. We hand you a route. StellarStart GLOBAL sits between your commercial plan and the rules of every jurisdiction it touches, then removes the friction between the two.

Entity formation and restructuring. Trademarks, patents and copyright across treaty systems. Cross-border taxation and transfer pricing. Data protection under GDPR, DPDP and CCPA. Contracts you can actually enforce. Litigation support when talking stops working.

Our core team is supported by StellarPartners, local practitioners who carry the jurisdictional detail so you get one accountable point of contact instead of five separate retainers.
